cases.question: Should filings F-1001 (Acme Logistics LLC) and F-1002 (ACME LOGISTICS, L.L.C.) be merged into one entity?
context: F-1001: Acme Logistics LLC, 400 Industrial Way, Columbus OH. Secured party: First National Bank. Filed 2023-04-12.
F-1002: ACME LOGISTICS, L.L.C., 400 Industrial Way, Columbus OH. Secured party: First National Bank. Filed 2024-01-30.
Fuzzy name match score F-1001 vs F-1002: 0.94
Ohio business registry: one active entity 'Acme Logistics LLC' registered at 400 Industrial Way, Columbus OH.
cases.answer: Yes, these filings should be merged. The fuzzy match score is 0.94, both filings list the identical address (400 Industrial Way, Columbus OH) and the same secured party (First National Bank), and the Ohio registry shows exactly one active entity with this name at this address. Three independent signals agree, so I assign merge confidence 0.92.
